app.name: Grown-ups Don't Play JANKEN for Nothing.
footer.note: POINTs are only for keeping score. No money is wagered.
setup.intro.label: About this app
setup.intro.summary: An app for a POINT battle based on how many times each player loses at rock-paper-scissors or other games. At the end, tap “{settle}” to see the most efficient way to settle up: how many POINTs move from whom to whom.
setup.intro.step1: Choose the players and BET POINT (handicaps are welcome!)
setup.intro.step3: Tap “{settle}” to see the POINTs to settle
setup.title: SET UP
setup.betHint: The POINTs lost each time a player loses. The loser's BET POINT is split equally among everyone else.
setup.betNote: Note: the more players, the fewer POINTs each win earns. 4–6 players is recommended.
setup.playersHint: Enter the names of the players ({min}–{max} people).
setup.confirmRemove: Remove {name}? Their loss record will also be deleted.
game.title: PLAY GAME
game.hint: Tap “{addLoss}” for the player who lost. Made a mistake? Tap “{undo}” to take it back. To change BET POINT mid-game, use “{backToSetup}”. The loss records are kept and Net POINTs are recalculated.
settle.title: Settlement
settle.transfersHint: Settle the POINTs as shown, and everyone is all square.
settle.confirmNewGame: Clear all losses and start a new game?
